_notes.source: Generated C in build-trace/main (read only), vtables and constants read from relocations and rodata of dump/exefs/main with tools/nso.py. No RTTI in the binary, so class names come from the exported getters that fit each layout and from the constructor; they are guesses where marked.
_notes.constructor: f_71006882d0 builds the fighter's module accessor; it allocates the 0xD70-byte KineticModule (stored at accessor+0x68), first with base vptr 0x7104F6F060, then the derived vptr 0x7104F88568. It builds the 11 energies in place, then registers each one through module vtable slot +0x48 (f_7100479bf0, add_energy(energy, id, attr_mask, -1)) and disables it through slot +0x130 (f_7100479540, unable_energy(id)).
_notes.energy_vtable_slots: Energy vtable (index*8): +0x18 per-frame update (slot 3), +0x20 returns a pointer to the current speed vector (slot 4, base f_71003b3540 = this+0x10), +0x40 reset_energy, +0x48 clear_speed, +0x50 clear_rot_speed, +0x58 mul_speed, +0x60 mul_accel, +0x68 reflect_speed, +0x70 reflect_accel, +0x78 on_consider_ground_friction, +0x80 off_consider_ground_friction (from the KineticEnergy__* exports, which dispatch through these slots). Base class (all no-op slots) = vptr 0x7104F64B60, which is also the static dummy energy (0x71052B7BA0) that KineticModule::get_energy returns for an id it cannot find.
_notes.module_vtable: 0x7104F88568: +0x40 f_7100479260 (sets the +0x1BD guard and calls clear_speed_all), +0x60 get_energy f_7100479d40, +0x80 per-frame update of all energies f_71004793a0, +0x90 clear_speed_all, +0xC0 get_sum_speed f_710047a760, +0xC8 get_sum_speed_x, +0xD0 get_sum_speed_y, +0x118 change_kinetic f_71004794b0, +0x120 get_kinetic_type f_710047af60, +0x128 enable_energy, +0x130 unable_energy, +0x138 is_enable_energy, +0x140 suspend_energy, +0x148 resume_energy, +0x150 is_suspend_energy, +0x158 add_speed, +0x168 sleep f_7100479730.
_notes.attr_masks: Mask registered per id: ids 0-3 = 0x1, id 4 = 0x2, ids 5 and 7 = 0x4, id 6 = 0x8, ids 8-10 = 0x10. get_sum_speed(mask) adds the speed of every enabled energy whose mask ANDs non-zero with the argument; a mask of -1 adds every enabled energy regardless of mask. It returns zero while module+0x1BC (sleep) is set. Suspended (+0x31) energies are still added to the sum; the per-frame update skips them.
_notes.null_safety: The KineticModule lua_bind wrappers load accessor+0x68 and then that module's vptr, so a null accessor faults. get_energy (f_7100479d40) has no bounds check on the fighter: +0x1B0 is 0, so it does a bare indexed load of the pointer at +0x30+0x18*id. Ids 11-15 return the constructor-zeroed pointer (null), and ids below 0 or above 15 read outside the entry table. The static dummy energy (vptr 0x7104F64B60) is returned only on the search path (+0x1B0 != 0) when no entry matches. The id-taking module methods enable/unable/is_enable/suspend/resume/is_suspend_energy first call slot +0x70 (f_7100479f00, has_energy). In indexed mode it returns count > id as an unsigned compare, so negative or out-of-range ids return false/no-op. Energy getters dereference the energy pointer directly. The address-returning ones do not dereference, but on a null energy they return a small bogus pointer.
_notes.types: The Normal setters take const phx::Vector2f& and copy 16 bytes, so phx::Vector2f is a 16-byte (SIMD-padded) type with x,y in the first 8 bytes. set_speed_3d and the RotNormal setters take const phx::Vector3f&, also 16 bytes.
_notes.certain_rule: 'certain' is used only where an exported getter returns the field value by a plain load from the receiver pointer (15 fields). Four other kinds of entry are 'probable' with a 'computed:' formula: getters that return the field's address (KineticEnergy::get_rotation; KineticEnergyNormal::get_accel, get_stable_speed, get_brake, get_limit_speed), speed getters that go through virtual slot +0x20, the id-lookup getters, and the lua_State wrapper sv_kinetic_energy::get_update_num. The offsets of the address-returning getters are exact, so a caller who accepts a reference return as a read can promote those five.
_notes.offsets: Every 'offset' is a single hex literal. Per-entry module fields give entry 0 and state 'stride 0x18' in the type. Some 'probable' entries describe several adjacent fields; their type string lists each one.
_notes.unresolved_trace_writers: Two trace-named writers of module lines 0x0/0x40/0x80/0xC0/0x100, f_7100468220 and f_71003e87a0 (reader f_7100469cb0), were opened. Their store patterns do not fit the module header: f_71003e87a0 writes 16-byte vectors at +0x10, +0x40, +0x90..+0xF0 and a byte at +0x110 of its object, which would overwrite the list vptr and the entry pointers. Their objects are therefore not established as the KineticModule. Most likely the trace saw earlier heap use of the same addresses, or a different object. Their 'sim state' classification of lines 0x0-0x80 is left unexplained. Also not resolved by name: f_710062e490 (2400-line function, writer of line 0x640 = Motion +0x60..+0x9F) and f_71006c2a40 (writer of line 0xB80; it zeroes +0x20, +0x50 and +0x8C of its argument, which fits a reset of the id-8 controller energy at 0xB20 but is not proven).

energies.evidence: Registered with id 0 and mask 0x1. The constructor initialises +0x84=-1, +0x88=1.0, +0x9C=1.0 and +0xB0=(1,1), which are the fields read and written by the FighterKineticEnergyMotion exports (chara_dir +0x88, speed_mul +0x9C, speed_mul_2nd +0xB0, update_flag +0xC0, ground_trans +0x84). The size before the next energy is 0xD0. Shares the KineticEnergyNormal vtable slots 10-16.

Registered with id 1 and mask 0x1. The constructor sets +0x3C/+0x40/+0x44 to -1.0 and +0x48 to 1.0. Those are the FighterKineticEnergyGravity get/set_stable_speed, brake, limit_speed and set_gravity_coefficient offsets (accel is at +0x38). It is not KineticEnergyNormal-derived: the friction slots are base no-ops and the layout differs. Its own speed slot f_71006d5560 returns +0x60 instead of +0x10 while the u32 at +0x70 is > 0. Size 0x80.

Registered with id 2 and mask 0x1. The class has the FighterKineticEnergyController accel_x/y mul/add fields at +0x8C..+0x98 (the size 0xB0 fits). Its update f_71006d3630 is the writer of module lines 0x740/0x780 in the trace and reads controller and params through the accessor. KineticEnergyNormal-derived.

energies.class_name_guess: FighterKineticEnergyStop (energy id 3, STOP) - name is a guess
energies.evidence: Registered with id 3 and mask 0x1. KineticEnergyNormal-derived, with the Normal flags at +0x80..+0x82 set by the constructor. Its clear_speed f_71006d8bc0 zeroes both +0x10 and an extra vector at +0x90. The u32 at +0xA0 is initialised to -1. Size 0xC0. The class is shared with slot 10 and is the base of the damage class. The name STOP for id 3 follows the community constant lists and is not proven by code here.

Registered with id 4 and mask 0x2. The exported sv_kinetic_energy::get_update_num accepts only id 4 and returns the u32 at +0xD0 of this energy. Its speed slot f_71006d8cc0 returns +0xC0 instead of +0x10 while +0xD0 > 0. Derived from the id-3 class (it shares slots 3, 5, 8, 10 and 19). Size 0xE0.

energies.class_name_guess: Jostle energy (energy id 5, JOSTLE) - name is a guess
energies.evidence: Registered with id 5 and mask 0x4. KineticEnergyNormal-derived, with +0x80=1 (consider ground normal on). Its update f_710047cae0 sums two accumulated vectors at +0x90 and +0xA0, scales by f32 +0xB0, writes accel +0x40 and stable speed +0x50 (one paired store), limit +0x70 and speed +0x10, runs the Normal update f_710047bf90, and then clears +0x90/+0xA0 every frame. This fits push-apart between fighters. Size 0xC0.

energies.class_name_guess: Ground-movement energy (energy id 6; moving-platform carry) - name is a guess
energies.evidence: Registered with id 6 and mask 0x8. A plain KineticEnergy subclass (not Normal) of size 0x60. Its update f_710047b8e0 branches on the situation kind from accessor+0x40, gets a ground velocity from GroundModule (accessor+0x58) virtual calls, and writes +0x10. Constructor sets +0x50=(1.0, 2.0) and +0x58=0.

energies.class_name_guess: Environment energy, probably ENV_WIND (energy id 7) - name is a guess
energies.evidence: Registered with id 7 and mask 0x4. A plain KineticEnergy subclass of size 0x80. Its update f_710047bbb0 calls the module at accessor+0x118 and writes speed +0x10, +0x40 and +0x60. Module slot +0x38 (f_71006cd9b0) loads three fighter params into +0x50, +0x70 and +0x74 of this energy. Constructor sets +0x74=-1.0 and +0x78=1.0.

energies.class_name_guess: Second controller-class energy (energy id 8; community lists name ids 8-10 *_NO_STOP or *_ANOTHER - unverified)
energies.evidence: Registered with id 8 and mask 0x10. It has the same vptr as slot 2 and the constructor initialises it the same way as slot 2.

Registered with id 9 and mask 0x10. It has the same vptr as slot 4. The trace shows the update f_71006d6650 and clear f_71006d8ce0 writing module line 0xC40, and the reset f_71006d8c90 writing 0xC80 (its +0xB0..+0xD0).

Registered with id 10 and mask 0x10. It has the same vptr as slot 3. The trace shows sv_kinetic_energy::set_stable_speed writing module line 0xD00, which is +0x50 (Normal stable_speed) of this energy.

fields.evidence: Constructor f_71006882d0 stores 0x7104F88568 (fighter KineticModule vtable) after the base vptr 0x7104F6F060.
Constructor stores the accessor here. change_kinetic, add_speed and the per-frame update f_71004793a0 pass it to the updater at +0x1C0.
Constructor stores 0x7104F6F1E8. The address module+0x10 is passed to the updater as the energy list (change_kinetic f_71004794b0, add_speed f_71004796f0).
Energy list capacity. The constructor writes 16, and 16 entries of 0x18 bytes from +0x30 end exactly at +0x1B0.
Energy count (11 for a fighter). add_energy f_7100479bf0 uses it as the insert index and increments it; get_energy, get_sum_speed and the update loop iterate up to it (64-bit load, low 32 bits used).
Pointer to the entry array. The constructor sets it to module+0x30, and add_energy indexes from it.

fields.type: u64 (KineticEnergy*); per-entry, stride 0x18, entries k=0..15 at +0x30+0x18*k
fields.formula: computed: when module+0x1B0 is 0 (the fighter case), an indexed load of the pointer at +0x30+0x18*id with no bounds check (ids 11-15 return null). Otherwise a linear search for id at +0x38+0x18*k, returning a static dummy energy if none matches.
fields.evidence: f_7100479d40 (slot +0x60). For the fighter, ids equal indexes, so it is a direct indexed load. Points inside the module at the offsets in 'energies'.

fields.type: u32; per-entry, stride 0x18, entries k=0..15 at +0x30+0x18*k
fields.evidence: Energy id of entry k (written from the id argument of add_energy f_7100479bf0; the constructor initialises it to -1). get_energy f_7100479d40 compares against it in search mode. For the fighter it equals k (0..10).

fields.type: u32 (bit mask); per-entry, stride 0x18, entries k=0..15 at +0x30+0x18*k
fields.evidence: Attribute mask (add_energy's 4th argument). get_sum_speed f_710047a760 and the update loop f_71004793a0 AND it with the caller's mask. Values are in _notes.attr_masks.

fields.type: u32; per-entry, stride 0x18, entries k=0..15 at +0x30+0x18*k
fields.evidence: Fifth argument of add_energy, stored per entry. It is -1 for all 11 fighter energies; the constructor zeroes it before registration. No reader was found among the module's own functions. Note that trace line 0x40 has unresolved writer/reader names (see _notes.unresolved_trace_writers).
add_energy sets it to 1 when the registered id differs from the insert index. get_energy and the slot +0x68/+0x70 lookups then search by id instead of indexing. It is 0 for the fighter.

The slot function f_710047af60 returns the u32 at +0x1B8. change_kinetic f_71004794b0 calls the updater at +0x1C0 and then stores the new type here. The trace marks line 0x180 as sim state, written by f_71004794b0 and named get_kinetic_type.

Sleep flag. KineticModule::sleep (slot +0x168, f_7100479730) stores bool&1 here. get_sum_speed f_710047a760 returns a zero vector while it is set. Init f_7100478df0 writes 0x100 as u16 to +0x1BC, so +0x1BC=0 and +0x1BD=1 there; slot +0x38 f_71006cd9b0 also writes it.
Re-entrancy guard. Slot +0x40 f_7100479260 sets it to 1, calls clear_speed_all (slot +0x90), then clears it. clear_speed_all f_710047a400 skips a vtable +0x170 check while it is set.

Set by init f_7100478df0, which calls its slot 0 with (module+0x1D0, accessor). The update loop f_71004793a0 calls its slot +0x20 for each enabled, mask-matching, non-suspended energy and then its slot +0x28. change_kinetic calls its slot +0x48 and add_speed its slot +0x38.

fields.formula: computed: no getter (layout from writers/readers only)
fields.evidence: Init f_7100478df0 passes module+0x1D0 to the updater's init. Nothing else in the module code touches 0x1D0-0x5CF, and the access trace shows no traffic there apart from the constant line 0x1C0.
Zeroed by the constructor and by init f_7100478df0; its use is not established.

fields.formula: computed: virtual slot +0x20 returns a pointer to the speed vector, then reads the f32 at offset 0 of it. For every class except Gravity and Damage that pointer is energy+0x10, so it is a load of +0x10. Gravity returns +0x60 while u32 +0x70 > 0, and the damage class returns +0xC0 while u32 +0xD0 > 0.
fields.evidence: f_71020f6460 calls vtable+0x20. The base implementation f_71003b3540 returns this+0x10, and Motion, Controller, Stop, Jostle, ground and env classes use it. The Normal clear_speed f_710047c540 and the Normal update f_710047bf90 write +0x10. Certain for the base-slot classes; for Gravity and Damage the getter can return the override vector instead.

f_71020f6580 returns the byte at +0x30. enable f_71020f6560 and unable f_71020f6570 write 1 and 0. KineticModule::is_enable_energy f_7100479590 looks the energy up by id and tests this byte, and get_sum_speed adds only energies with it set.

fields.evidence: f_7100479690 reads it; suspend f_71004795f0 and resume f_7100479640 write 1 and 0, and resume_energy_all f_710047a680 clears it on all entries (a frequent writer in the trace).
